uncertainty_notes: No operator anchors exist in this capture at all. Every fact about starting position, and therefore about the correctness of the predicted-position trace this tool produces, is unverifiable against this capture alone.

This manifest exists primarily to exercise the gate-replay tool and produce a decision record for review, NOT to support any claim about accurate marker identification in this run -- see part E of the accompanying report.
No independent wheel-speed or odometer ground truth exists. The physical-timing gate's speed bound is inherited from QUORUM's own provisional velocity model, not independently validated here.

Because start position is unconfirmed, an operator declaring a real starting marker (e.g. via a future anchored capture) is a prerequisite for treating any ACCEPT_EXPECTED_MARKER event in this run's decision CSV as evidence of a specific physical location.
